026        public static enum Stage {
027                VISIT_SHRINES,
028                RETURN_TO_GILEAD,
029                COMPLETED,
030        }
031        
032        public static String VISITED_SHRINE_JANGALA = "$lpp_visitedShrineJangala";
033        public static String VISITED_SHRINE_KILLA = "$lpp_visitedShrineKilla";
034        public static String VISITED_SHRINE_VOLTURN = "$lpp_visitedShrineVolturn";
035        public static String VISITED_SHRINE_CHICOMOZTOC = "$lpp_visitedShrineChicomoztoc";
036        public static String VISITED_SHRINE_GILEAD = "$lpp_visitedShrineGilead";
037        public static String VISITED_SHRINE_BEHOLDER = "$lpp_visitedShrineBeholder";
038        
039        protected int xpRewardBase = 10000;
040        protected int xpRewardIncrease = 2000;
041        protected int num_rewards_given = 0;
042        
043        protected MarketAPI volturn;
044        protected MarketAPI gilead;
045        protected MarketAPI jangala;
046        protected MarketAPI hesperus;
047        protected SectorEntityToken killa;
048        protected SectorEntityToken beholder_station;
049        
050        @Override
051        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
052                // if already accepted by the player, abort
053                if (!setGlobalReference("$lpp_ref", "$lpp_inProgress")) {
054                        return false;
055                }
056                
057                volturn = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("volturn");
058                if (volturn == null) return false;
059                //if (!volturn.getFactionId().equals("sindrian_diktat")) return false;
060                
061                gilead = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("gilead");
062                if (gilead == null) return false;
063                
064                jangala = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("jangala");
065                if (jangala == null) return false;
066
067                hesperus = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("hesperus");
068                if (hesperus == null) return false;
069                
070                // Find Killa!
071                StarSystemAPI yma =  Global.getSector().getStarSystem("yma");
072                for (SectorEntityToken curr : yma.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.LUDDIC_SHRINE)) {
073                        killa = curr;
074                        break;
075                }
076                if (killa == null) return false;
077                
078                // Find Beholder Station!
079                StarSystemAPI kumarikandam =  Global.getSector().getStarSystem("kumari kandam");
080                for (SectorEntityToken curr : kumarikandam.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.LUDDIC_SHRINE)) {
081                        beholder_station = curr;
082                        break;
083                }
084                if (beholder_station == null) return false;
085                
086                setStartingStage(Stage.VISIT_SHRINES);
087                addSuccessStages(Stage.COMPLETED);
088                
089                setStoryMission();
090                //addTag(Tags.INTEL_SHRINES);
091        
092                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.RETURN_TO_GILEAD, "$lpp_visitedAllShrines");
093                
094                makeImportant(gilead, "$lpp_finishPilgrimage", Stage.RETURN_TO_GILEAD);
095                //setStageOnMemoryFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, gilead, "$lpp_completed");
096                
097                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, "$lpp_completed");
098                
099                
100                setName("The Pilgrim's Path");
101                setRepFactionChangesNone();
102                setRepPersonChangesNone();
103        
104                beginStageTrigger(Stage.COMPLETED);
105                triggerMakeNonStoryCritical("jangala", "hesperus", "gilead", "volturn");
106                triggerSetGlobalMemoryValue("$lpp_missionCompleted", true);
107                endTrigger();
108                
109                return true;
110        }
111        
112        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
113                        set("$lpp_stage", getCurrentStage());
114        }
115
116        @Override
117        protected boolean callAction(String action, String ruleId, final InteractionDialogAPI dialog,
118                                                                 List<Token> params, final Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
119                
120                if ("giveVisitXP".equals(action))
121                {
122                        num_rewards_given++;
123                        long xp_to_give = (long)(num_rewards_given * xpRewardIncrease + xpRewardBase);
124                        Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().addXP(xp_to_give, dialog.getTextPanel());
125                        return true;
126                }
127                else if ("giveLastVisitXP".equals(action))
128                {
129                        num_rewards_given++;
130                        long xp_to_give = (long)(num_rewards_given * xpRewardIncrease + xpRewardBase);
131                        
132                        // it's possible the player visited shrines before taking on the mission
133                        // so add all that XP as a lump sum onto the end
134                        int visited_shrines = getNumberOfShrinesVisited();
135                        if (num_rewards_given < visited_shrines)
136                        {
137                                for (int i = num_rewards_given; i < visited_shrines; i++)
138                                {
139                                        xp_to_give += (long)(i * xpRewardIncrease + xpRewardBase);
140                                }
141                        }
142                        
143                        Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().addXP(xp_to_give, dialog.getTextPanel());
144                        return true;
145                }
146                else if ("checkShrinesVisited".equals(action)) {
147                        
148                        int visited_shrines = getNumberOfShrinesVisited();
149                        int numberOfShrinesToComplete = 6;
150                        //System.out.print("checkShrinesVisited = " + Integer.toString(visited_shrines));
151                        
152                        if( visited_shrines >= numberOfShrinesToComplete) {
153                                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$lpp_visitedAllShrines", true);
154                        }
155                        return true;
156                }
157                else if ("postMissionCleanup".equals(action)) {
158                        // clean up any unneeded memory things.
159                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$lpp_didHesperusFirstShrineAttempt");
160                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$lpp_didHookStart");
161                        gilead.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$lpp_finishPilgrimage");
162                        return true;
163                }
164                
165                return super.callAction(action, ruleId, dialog, params, memoryMap);
166        }

172                float pad = 3f;

188                float opad = 10f;

190
191                if (currentStage == Stage.VISIT_SHRINES) {
192                        info.addPara("Visit the six shrines of the Pilgrim's Path. The pilgrimage is traditionally completed by returning to Gilead, in the Canaan system.", opad);

194                else if (currentStage == Stage.RETURN_TO_GILEAD) {
195                        info.addPara("Return to the shrine of Gilead in the Canaan system to complete the Pilgrim's Path.", opad);
196                }
197
198                LuddicShrineIntel.addShowShrinesButton(this, width, height, info);
199        }

237        public void buttonPressConfirmed(Object buttonId, IntelUIAPI ui) {
238                if (buttonId == LuddicShrineIntel.BUTTON_SHOW_SHRINES) {
239                        LuddicShrineIntel.toggleShrineList(this, ui);

241                }

244        
245        
246        public int getNumberOfShrinesVisited() {
247                int count = 0;
248                
249                for (IntelInfoPlugin intel : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(LuddicShrineIntel.class)) {
250                        LuddicShrineIntel shrine = (LuddicShrineIntel) intel;
251                        if (LuddicShrineIntel.isVisited(shrine.getEntity())) {
252                                count++;
253                        }
254                }
255
256                System.out.print(" Shrine count found = " + count);
257                return count;
258        }
